    Profile

    Theresa is a knight of Wratharis and the war-hating instructor of Lamia. She has earned the nickname Ruinmaker due to her penchant for destroying everything in sight while on the battlefield. When she is far away from combat, she can often be seen peacefully admiring the flowers and gently teasing those about her.

    Origin: Wratharis
    Gender: Female
    Height: 164cm
    Weight: 51kg
    Birthday: Dec 8
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Nightmare Cherry Blossom
    Likes: Tranquility, poppies
    Hobbies: Admiring flowers in silence
    Illust: だーくろ
    CV: 椎名へきる
